blocks.text: Present Perfect ning yana bir muhim vazifasi — **hayot tajribasi** haqida gapirish: hayotimda (hozirgacha) biror ishni qilganmanmi yoki yo'qmi. Bunda harakat **qachon** bo'lgani aytilmaydi va muhim emas — muhimi, shunday tajriba bor-yo'qligi. O'zbek tilida buning aniq mosi bor — «**-gan**» + shaxs qo'shimchasi: «Men Londonda **bo'lganman**», «Siz hech palov **pishirganmisiz**?», «U hech qachon samolyotda **uchmagan**». Ya'ni o'zbekcha «-ganman» — inglizcha **have + V3** ning eng yaxshi tarjimasi.

rows: U hech qachon chet elga chiqmagan.

blocks.text: **ever** savolda ishlatiladi: **Have** you **ever** ...? — «Hech ...ganmisiz?», ya'ni hayotingizda bir marta bo'lsa ham. O'rni — ega va V3 orasida: Has she **ever** cooked plov? Javob turlicha bo'lishi mumkin: Yes, I **have**. / Yes, once. / Yes, many times. / No, I **haven't**. / No, **never**.

items.text: **Have** you **ever seen** a camel? — Yes, I **have**.
**Has** Tom **ever been** to Tashkent? — No, he **hasn't**.

blocks.text: **never** = not ever: I**'ve never** played golf. never ning o'zi inkor, shuning uchun unga haven't qo'shilmaydi: «I haven't never» — xato (ikki inkor). O'zbekchada esa «**hech qachon** borma**gan**man» — ikki inkor odatiy hol. Shu sababli o'zbeklar ko'pincha «I haven't never been» deb yuboradi. To'g'risi — bitta inkor: I**'ve never been** yoki I **haven't ever been** (ikkinchisi kamroq ishlatiladi).

items.text: She**'s never been** late for work.

blocks.text: Tajriba necha marta bo'lganini so'rash: **How many times have** you ...? — «Necha marta ...?». Javobda: **once** (bir marta), **twice** (ikki marta), **three times**, **several times** (bir necha marta), **many times** (ko'p marta). **before** — «ilgari, bundan oldin»: I've been here **before**. Biror narsa **birinchi marta** bo'layotgan bo'lsa: **It's the first time** I**'ve** ... — «birinchi marta ...». Bu iborada ham Present Perfect keladi: It's the first time I**'ve eaten** sushi («I eat» emas).

items.text: I**'ve been** to Moscow three times.
It's the first time I**'ve flown**.

blocks.text: **go** fe'lining Present Perfect da ikki shakli bor. **has gone** — ketgan va **hozir o'sha yoqda** (hali qaytmagan). **has been** — borgan va **qaytib kelgan** (bu — tajriba). O'zbekchada ham shu farq bor: «ketgan» va «bo'lgan». Shuning uchun «Hech ... bo'lganmisiz?» doim **been to** bilan: Have you ever **been to** London? («been in London» yoki «gone to London» emas).
Tajriba — Present Perfect, tafsilot — Past Simple

Tajriba haqida savol Present Perfect bilan beriladi, lekin suhbat **aniq bir voqeaga** — qachon, qayerda, qanday — o'tishi bilan Past Simple boshlanadi: **Have** you **ever been** to London? — Yes, I **have**. I **went** there in 2019. — Oh, did you like it? Qachon bo'lganini so'rash ham faqat Past Simple da: **When did** you **go**? («When have you been» emas). Batafsil — 20-darsda.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Have you ever been in London?» → been **to** London.; «I haven't never been there.» → I**'ve never been** there. (bitta inkor); «She has gone to London three times.» → She**'s been** to London three times. (borib kelgan); «I have been in Samarkand last year.» → I **went** to Samarkand last year. (aniq vaqt — Past Simple); «It's the first time I see snow.» → It's the first time I**'ve seen** snow.; «Did you ever eat plov?» (amerikancha) → **Have** you **ever eaten** plov?

O'zbekcha qolip yordam beradi: «**-ganman**» → I've + V3; «**hech ...-ganmisiz?**» → Have you **ever** + V3?; «**hech qachon -maganman**» → I've **never** + V3 (inglizchada inkor faqat bitta!); «**bo'lgan**» → **been**, «**ketgan**» → **gone**.
**been** — be fe'lining ham V3 shakli: I**'ve been** ill / busy / tired. there has been — 38-dars. Present Perfect va Past Simple farqi — 20-dars, how long ...? — 18-dars.

rows: bir marta, ikki marta, ko'p marta

examples.title: **Have** you **ever** ...? — short answers
examples.description: Tajriba haqida savol: **Have / Has** + ega + **ever** + V3? Javob: Yes, I have. / Yes, once. / No, they haven't. / No, never.

sentences.text: **Have** you **ever been** to Samarkand? — Yes, I **have**, twice.
sentences.translation: Hech **Samarqandda bo'lganmisiz**? — Ha, **bo'lganman**, ikki marta.

sentences.text: **Has** Emma **ever eaten** plov? — Yes, she loves it!
sentences.translation: Emma hech **palov yeganmi**? — Ha, uni juda yaxshi ko'radi!

sentences.text: **Have** your parents **ever flown** in a plane? — No, they **haven't**.
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz hech **samolyotda uchganmi**? — Yo'q, **uchishmagan**.

sentences.text: Aziz, **have** you **ever ridden** a horse? — Yes, once, in the mountains.
sentences.translation: Aziz, hech **ot minganmisan**? — Ha, bir marta, tog'da.

sentences.text: **Has** your brother **ever won** a competition? — No, never.
sentences.translation: Akang hech **musobaqada g'olib bo'lganmi**? — Yo'q, hech qachon.

sentences.text: Tell me, **have** you **ever met** a famous person?
sentences.translation: Ayting-chi, hech **mashhur odam bilan uchrashganmisiz**?

sentences.text: **Have** they **ever lived** abroad? — Yes, they lived in Germany for a while.
sentences.translation: Ular hech **chet elda yashaganmi**? — Ha, bir muddat Germaniyada yashashgan.

sentences.text: So, Madina, **has** anyone **ever told** you that you look like your mum?
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, Madina, hech kim senga onangga o'xshashingni **aytganmi**?

sentences.text: Excuse me, **have** you **ever used** this ticket machine? How does it work?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, hech bu chipta avtomatidan **foydalanganmisiz**? U qanday ishlaydi?

sentences.text: Sarah, **has** your car **ever broken** down on the motorway?
sentences.translation: Sara, mashinangiz hech avtomagistralda **buzilib qolganmi**?

examples.title: Experiences: **I've** ... **before**
examples.description: Hayot tajribasi — qachon bo'lgani aytilmaydi: I've tried ..., She has worked as ... O'zbekchada «-gan»: tatib ko'rganman, ishlagan.

sentences.text: **I've tried** Japanese food before, and I really liked it.
sentences.translation: Ilgari **yapon taomini tatib ko'rganman**, menga juda yoqqan.

sentences.text: My grandfather **has visited** Mecca three times.
sentences.translation: Bobom uch marta **Makkani ziyorat qilgan**.

sentences.text: We**'ve stayed** in this hotel before — the rooms are lovely.
sentences.translation: Bu mehmonxonada ilgari **to'xtaganmiz** — xonalari juda yaxshi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **has worked** as a tour guide, so she knows Bukhara very well.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ekskursiya yetakchisi bo'lib **ishlagan**, shuning uchun Buxoroni juda yaxshi biladi.

sentences.text: Tom **has read** all the Harry Potter books, some of them twice.
sentences.translation: Tom Garri Potter kitoblarining hammasini **o'qigan**, ba'zilarini ikki marta.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has run** a marathon, and he wants to do another one.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **marafon yugurgan**, yana bittasida qatnashmoqchi.

sentences.text: My sister **has been** on television — on a cooking programme!
sentences.translation: Opam **televizorga chiqqan** — pazandachilik ko'rsatuvida!

sentences.text: James **has climbed** Ben Nevis, the highest mountain in Britain.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Britaniyaning eng baland tog'i — Ben-Nevisga **chiqqan**.

sentences.text: Our teacher **has taught** in five different countries.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz besh xil mamlakatda **dars bergan**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I know this joke — I**'ve heard** it before.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu latifani bilaman — ilgari **eshitganman**.

examples.title: **never**: I**'ve never** ...
examples.description: never = not ever, bitta inkor yetarli: I've never ... («I haven't never» emas). Nobody ... ever — «hech kim ... -magan». O'zbekchada: «hech qachon -magan».

sentences.text: I**'ve never been** to London, but I really want to go.
sentences.translation: **Hech qachon Londonda bo'lmaganman**, lekin juda borgim bor.

sentences.text: My grandmother **has never used** a computer.
sentences.translation: Buvim **hech qachon kompyuterdan foydalanmagan**.

sentences.text: We**'ve never seen** snow like this in Tashkent!
sentences.translation: Toshkentda bunaqa qorni **hech qachon ko'rmaganmiz**!

sentences.text: Sarah **has never tasted** horse meat, and she doesn't want to.
sentences.translation: Sara **ot go'shtini hech qachon tatib ko'rmagan**, tatib ko'rishni xohlamaydi ham.

sentences.text: It's strange, but Bekzod **has never learnt** to swim.
sentences.translation: G'alati, lekin Bekzod **suzishni o'rganmagan**.

sentences.text: My parents **have never had** a serious argument.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam **hech qachon jiddiy janjallashmagan**.

sentences.text: Emma **has never missed** a single lesson.
sentences.translation: Emma **birorta ham darsni qoldirmagan**.

sentences.text: Tom is twenty-five, but he **has never driven** a car.
sentences.translation: Tom yigirma besh yoshda, lekin **hech qachon mashina haydamagan**.

sentences.text: Honestly, I **haven't ever** felt so tired in my life.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, hayotimda **hech qachon** bunchalik **charchamaganman**.

sentences.text: Nobody in my family **has ever been** to America.
sentences.translation: Oilamizda **hech kim Amerikada bo'lmagan**.

examples.title: How many times? **once**, **twice**, **many times**
examples.description: Necha marta: How many times have you ...? — once, twice, three times, several times, many times.

sentences.text: How many times **have** you **been** to Bukhara? — Three times.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda **necha marta bo'lgansiz**? — Uch marta.

sentences.text: I**'ve seen** this film twice, and I still love it.
sentences.translation: Bu filmni **ikki marta ko'rganman**, hali ham yoqadi.

sentences.text: Aziz **has failed** his driving test three times.
sentences.translation: Aziz haydovchilik imtihonidan **uch marta yiqilgan**.

sentences.text: My father **has been** to China many times on business.
sentences.translation: Otam ish yuzasidan **Xitoyda ko'p marta bo'lgan**.

sentences.text: Emma **has only been** to Scotland once, but she wants to go back.
sentences.translation: Emma **Shotlandiyada faqat bir marta bo'lgan**, lekin yana borishni xohlaydi.

sentences.text: We**'ve moved** house four times in ten years.
sentences.translation: Biz o'n yil ichida **to'rt marta uy ko'chganmiz**.

sentences.text: Our cat **has run** away twice, but it always comes back.
sentences.translation: Mushugimiz **ikki marta qochib ketgan**, lekin doim qaytib keladi.

sentences.text: Madina **has read** this book several times.
sentences.translation: Madina bu kitobni **bir necha marta o'qigan**.

sentences.text: How many countries **has** your uncle **visited**? — More than thirty!
sentences.translation: Amakingiz **nechta davlatda bo'lgan**? — O'ttizdan ko'p!

sentences.text: Bekzod, how many times **have** I **told** you to close the door?
sentences.translation: Bekzod, senga eshikni yop deb **necha marta aytganman**?

examples.title: **gone** or **been**?
examples.description: **has gone** — ketgan, hozir o'sha yoqda; **has been** — borib kelgan (tajriba). Where have you been? — «Qayerda eding?»

sentences.text: Madina **has gone** to Samarkand for the weekend.
sentences.translation: Madina dam olish kunlari uchun **Samarqandga ketgan**.

sentences.text: Madina **has been** to Samarkand many times.
sentences.translation: Madina **Samarqandda ko'p marta bo'lgan**.

sentences.text: Where's Tom? — He**'s gone** to the dentist.
sentences.translation: Tom qani? — **Tish shifokoriga ketgan**.

sentences.text: Hi, Tom! Where **have** you **been**? — I**'ve been** to the dentist.
sentences.translation: Salom, Tom! **Qayerda eding**? — **Tish shifokorida edim**.

sentences.text: Mum isn't at home — she**'s gone** shopping.
sentences.translation: Oyim uyda yo'q — **xarid qilgani ketgan**.

sentences.text: Your shoes are dirty. **Have** you **been** to the park?
sentences.translation: Poyabzalingiz kir. **Parkka borib keldingizmi**?

sentences.text: My parents **have gone** on holiday, so I'm alone at home.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam **ta'tilga ketishgan**, shuning uchun uyda yolg'izman.

sentences.text: My parents **have been** on holiday, and they look very relaxed now.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam **ta'tilda bo'lib kelishdi**, hozir juda dam olgan ko'rinishadi.

sentences.text: Sorry, Mr Brown isn't here. He**'s gone** home.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, janob Braun bu yerda emas. U **uyiga ketgan**.

sentences.text: Aziz **has never been** to the sea, but his brother **has gone** there this summer.
sentences.translation: Aziz hech qachon **dengizda bo'lmagan**, akasi esa bu yoz **dengizga ketgan**.

examples.title: It's the first time I**'ve** ... / I**'ve** ... **before**
examples.description: «Birinchi marta» — It's the first time + Present Perfect («I eat» emas). **before** — «ilgari, bundan oldin».

sentences.text: This is the first time I**'ve eaten** sushi.
sentences.translation: Sushini **birinchi marta yeyapman**.

sentences.text: It's the first time Emma **has visited** Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: Emma O'zbekistonga **birinchi marta kelgan**.

sentences.text: Is this the first time you**'ve driven** in the snow?
sentences.translation: Qorda **birinchi marta mashina haydayapsizmi**?

sentences.text: It's the second time Bekzod **has lost** his phone this month!
sentences.translation: Bu oy Bekzod telefonini **ikkinchi marta yo'qotdi**!

sentences.text: Don't be nervous — I**'ve done** this before.
sentences.translation: Asabiylashmang — buni **ilgari qilganman**.

sentences.text: **Have** we **met** before? Your face looks familiar.
sentences.translation: Biz **ilgari uchrashganmizmi**? Yuzingiz tanish ko'rinyapti.

sentences.text: Madina **has never cooked** for so many guests before.
sentences.translation: Madina ilgari hech qachon shuncha mehmonga **ovqat pishirmagan**.

sentences.text: Wow, I**'ve never seen** such a beautiful sunset before!
sentences.translation: Voy, bunday go'zal quyosh botishini **hech qachon ko'rmaganman**!

sentences.text: Our team **has won** the cup for the first time in history!
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz tarixda **birinchi marta kubokni yutdi**!

sentences.text: Sarah **has been** to many countries, but she **has never seen** a place like Khiva.
sentences.translation: Sara ko'p davlatlarda **bo'lgan**, lekin Xivaga o'xshash **joyni hech qachon ko'rmagan**.

examples.title: **Have** you **ever** ...? — Yes, I **went** ... last year
examples.description: Tajriba — Present Perfect; tafsilot (qachon, qayerda, qanday) — Past Simple. Batafsil — 20-dars.

sentences.text: **Have** you **ever been** to Istanbul? — Yes, I **went** there in 2022.
sentences.translation: Hech **Istanbulda bo'lganmisiz**? — Ha, 2022-yilda **borganman**.

sentences.text: **Has** Tom **ever cooked** for you? — Yes, he **made** pasta last week.
sentences.translation: Tom hech sizga **ovqat pishirganmi**? — Ha, o'tgan hafta makaron **tayyorladi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has met** the president! He **shook** his hand at a conference.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **prezident bilan uchrashgan**! Bir konferensiyada u bilan **qo'l berib ko'rishgan**.

sentences.text: **Have** your children **ever been** ill abroad? — Yes, once. Our son **got** a fever in Turkey.
sentences.translation: Bolalaringiz chet elda hech **kasal bo'lganmi**? — Ha, bir marta. O'g'limiz Turkiyada **isitmaladi**.

sentences.text: My uncle **has been** to Australia. He **stayed** there for a month.
sentences.translation: Amakim **Avstraliyada bo'lgan**. U yerda bir oy **turgan**.

sentences.text: Emma, **have** you **ever tried** kazy? — Yes, I **tried** it at a wedding, and I loved it.
sentences.translation: Emma, hech **qazi tatib ko'rganmisan**? — Ha, to'yda **tatib ko'rganman**, juda yoqqan.

sentences.text: Madina **has won** a prize for her paintings. She **got** it last spring.
sentences.translation: Madina rasmlari uchun **mukofot olgan**. Uni o'tgan bahorda **olgan**.

sentences.text: I**'ve seen** that musician live. He **was** fantastic!
sentences.translation: Bu musiqachini jonli ijroda **ko'rganman**. U **ajoyib edi**!

sentences.text: **Has** anyone in your family **ever lived** in London? — My aunt **did**, for two years.
sentences.translation: Oilangizda hech kim **Londonda yashaganmi**? — Xolam **yashagan**, ikki yil.

sentences.text: We**'ve been** to that restaurant. We **went** there for my birthday, and the food **was** excellent.
sentences.translation: U restoranda **bo'lganmiz**. Tug'ilgan kunimda **borgandik**, taomlari a'lo edi.

examples.title: Dialogue: Have you ever tried Uzbek food?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ever, never, been, gone va tafsilot uchun Past Simple — jonli suhbatda.

sentences.text: — **Have** you **ever tried** Uzbek food, James?
sentences.translation: — Jeyms, hech **o'zbek taomlarini tatib ko'rganmisiz**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I **have**. A friend **took** me to an Uzbek restaurant in London last year.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **ko'rganman**. O'tgan yili bir do'stim meni Londondagi o'zbek restoraniga **olib borgan**.

sentences.text: — Really? What **did** you **eat** there?
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? U yerda **nima yedingiz**?

sentences.text: — Plov, of course! But I**'ve never eaten** samsa.
sentences.translation: — Albatta, palov! Lekin **hech qachon somsa yemaganman**.

sentences.text: — Oh, that's a shame! **Have** you **ever been** to Uzbekistan?
sentences.translation: — E, attang! Hech **O'zbekistonda bo'lganmisiz**?

sentences.text: — No, **never**. But my sister **has been** to Samarkand twice.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **hech qachon**. Lekin singlim **Samarqandda ikki marta bo'lgan**.

sentences.text: — **Has** she? **Did** she **like** it?
sentences.translation: — Shundaymi? Unga **yoqdimi**?

sentences.text: — She loved it. She**'s gone** there again this month, actually.
sentences.translation: — Juda yoqqan. Aslida, bu oy u yerga yana **ketgan**.

sentences.text: — Lucky her! I**'ve always wanted** to see the Registan.
sentences.translation: — Omadi bor ekan! Men **doim Registonni ko'rishni orzu qilganman**.

sentences.text: — Then come with me in May! I**'ve already bought** my ticket.
sentences.translation: — Unda may oyida men bilan boring! Men chiptamni **olib qo'yganman**.
